recipes.label: Order a sniper to go into hiding
recipes.startdescription:
To the dark. Our enemy won't be able to find us, or harm us. And when we choose to strike again, it will be with the advantage of surprise...

[A Hidden Ally will not be targeted by most Enemy offensive actions, and will also have their aspects increased until the next time they are used.]
recipes.description: Here we wait. Here we bristle with anticipation.

recipes.label: Consult with a Sniper?
recipes.startdescription: If the infantry and tanks are our hammers, these men are our scalpels. I can order them into a hiding place to increase their effectiveness.

recipes.label: Bury a Fallen Ally
recipes.startdescription: Their war is over, but ours isn't. If we have time and effort to spare, we could bury them properly. [You will gain a memory from this.]
recipes.description: They Fought, and now they rest in a proper grave. I think about them briefly, and move on.

recipes.label: Bury a Fallen Ally?
recipes.startdescription: With some effort and time, I can bury these allies to give them some proper rest. Or if I'm desperate enough, I could do something else with them...

recipes.label: Pointless
recipes.startdescription: There is nothing to look back on. There is no meaning to this.

recipes.label: <color=red>Worthless<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription: <color=red>This is all they deserve.<color=#005500>

recipes.label: Refresh an ally with Provisions?
recipes.startdescription: If I have extra provisions to spare, I can give them to my exhuasted allies to get them back in the fight sooner. Certain allies may need more provisions.

recipes.label: Refresh an ally with Provisions?
recipes.startdescription: If I have extra provisions to spare, I can give them to my exhuasted allies to get them back in the fight sooner.
recipes.description: Extra rations and rest. Back in the fight.

recipes.label: Refresh an ally with Provisions?
recipes.startdescription: If I have extra provisions to spare, I can give them to my exhuasted allies to get them back in the fight sooner.
recipes.description: Extra rations and rest. Back in the fight.

recipes.label: Assistance From Locals!
recipes.startdescription: Our assistance to the locals here has given an unexpected boon, some townspeople come forward to tell us about the enemy...
recipes.description: The locals have shared information about enemy positions and composition. We can use this to our advantage.

recipes.label: Learn from a slain creature?
recipes.startdescription: This creature fought and lost, but in the breaking of this cadaver, I may learn more about the forging of monsters.
recipes.description: What is broken can be reforged into something deadlier. Knowledge is strength, after all.

recipes.label: Learn from a slain creature?
recipes.startdescription: This creature fought and lost, but in the breaking of this cadaver, I may learn more about the forging of monsters.
recipes.description: What is broken can be reforged into something deadlier. Knowledge is strength, after all.

recipes.label: Learn from a fallen monster?
recipes.startdescription: My friend told me to learn about monsters, but I have no idea where to start. I should take this somewhere else.

recipes.label: My Tormentor
recipes.startdescription: The monster called Exile is here. And I am afraid.

recipes.label: My Friend
recipes.startdescription: My Comrade-in-Arms. I should talk to him.

recipes.label: My Comrade
recipes.startdescription: My Comrade-in-Duty. I should talk to him.

recipes.label: Why?
recipes.startdescription: These people don't have a future. Why should I waste time allieviating their suffering?

recipes.label: <color=red>Useless<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription: <color=red>All they are getting from me is fire and agony.<color=#005500>

recipes.label: Hope, Denied
recipes.startdescription: I'm not trying to get somewhere safer, not anymore.

recipes.label: Relief, Denied
recipes.startdescription: Their wounded are their problem, not mine.

recipes.label: <color=red>Hope, Rejected<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription: <color=red>My hope was unmade. Theirs will be unmade too, eventually.<color=#005500>

recipes.label: <color=red>Relief, Rejected<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription: <color=red>They will probably die from their wounds. Who is going to help them? The Germans, the Soviets? Certainly not me.<color=#005500>

recipes.label: Emptiness
recipes.startdescription: If there's a God, he had abandoned me a long time ago.

recipes.label: <color=red>Nothingness<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription: <color=red>If there's a God, he will have to beg my forgiveness.<color=#005500>

recipes.label: A Victory!
recipes.startdescription: In our victory, we hear a song, a hint. The secrets of this creature are ours, now.

recipes.label: A Victory!
recipes.startdescription: In our victory, we hear a voice, a hint. The secrets of this creature are ours, now.

recipes.label: The Songs of Water and Mist
recipes.startdescription: The clicking and keening of the birds overhead begins to sound like something else entirely. In tinny voices of flute-breeze and wood-children, the birds exchange secrets and gossip. 'The sword,' a chorus of them sing. 'The sword...'
recipes.description: A little closer to the sword, now.

recipes.label: Contemplate under night?
recipes.startdescription: The sun has fully receded to nothingness. I have some time to rest, before I go back towards an ending. What might I ponder, under the absence of light?

recipes.label: Contemplate under night?
recipes.startdescription: The sun has fully receded to nothingness. I have some time to rest, before I go back towards an ending. What might I ponder, under the absence of light?
recipes.description: Nothing consequential, I suppose.

recipes.label: Contemplate under the sun?
recipes.startdescription: The sun has reached its zenith. I find some time to rest, before duty calls me back. What might I ponder, under the light of the sun?

recipes.label: Contemplate under the sun?
recipes.startdescription: The sun has reached its zenith. I find some time to rest, before duty calls me back. What might I ponder, under the light of the sun?
recipes.description: Nothing consequential, I suppose.

recipes.label: Contemplate under the sunset?
recipes.startdescription: The sun is retreating from the moon. I find some time to rest, before liberation calls me back. What might I ponder, under the fading light?

recipes.label: Contemplate under sunset?
recipes.startdescription: The sun is retreating from the moon. I find some time to rest, before liberation calls me back. What might I ponder, under the fading light?
recipes.description: Nothing consequential, I suppose.

recipes.label: Prepare ally to Evacuate Early
recipes.startdescription: We will have to leave eventually. I want this one to leave earlier than the others, though.
recipes.description: Done. This one is ready to bail out on command.

recipes.label: Cancel preparations to Evacuate Early
recipes.startdescription: This one is prepared to leave before the others. I could order otherwise.
recipes.description: Done. This one will evacuate with the others.

recipes.label: Cannibalise the Fallen?
recipes.startdescription: I'm not about to stoop that low. They don't deserve this.

recipes.label: Consult with a companion?
recipes.startdescription: My Friend, My Comrade in strife. I can talk with them if I have some time, or have them do something they're good at.

recipes.label: Consult with a companion?
recipes.startdescription: My 'Friend'. I can talk with them if I have some time, or have them do something they're good at. Some things I won't make them do.

recipes.label: Unfettered
recipes.startdescription: The rules of war are not my rules. [Some things have changed.]

recipes.label: Consult with a Future Enemy
recipes.startdescription: <color=red>They're just going to turn on me eventually.<color=#005500>

recipes.label: Consult with Vanja?
recipes.startdescription:
I find Vanja by his usual small spot in our camp.

'Y-Yes mister ? Can I help s-somehow... ?'

recipes.label: Consult with a child?
recipes.startdescription: 'I-I can help mister... I can h-help you in any way you want...'

recipes.label: <color=red>Dead Weight<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription:
It takes me time to find Vanja, the boy was hiding from me again. When I find him he's shaking at my presence.

'P-Please... I-I am scared...'

recipes.label: Consult with Eva?
recipes.startdescription:
I find Eva sitting alone once more. The woman at first ignores me and keeps staring with her empty expression before she eventually looks up at me.

'What do you want from me this time ?'

recipes.label: Consult with a grieving mother?
recipes.startdescription:
Finding Eva stopped being a difficulty ever since I secluded myself from others. This time she speaks nearly immediately when I arrive.

'I see you finally undersand. Good.'

recipes.label: <color=red>Loathsome Thing<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription:
Just like others, Eva started avoiding me whenever possible. When I finally corner her, she can't look me in the eyes.

'Just tell me what to do and leave.'

recipes.label: Consult with Tibor?
recipes.startdescription:
I find our doctor slowly changing his bandages again. The sight of his burns under them still unsettles me.

'I can still help others somewhat, don't worry about it.'

recipes.label: Consult with a burnt doctor?
recipes.startdescription:
Whatever repulsion I had at the sight of Tibor's burns is long gone.

'Sorry... But even I can't help with what you are going throught right now.'

recipes.label: <color=red>Burnt Husk<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription:
When I find Tibor changing his bandages, he immediately drops his action and speaks to me with his burns laid bare. He knows it's best not to keep me waiting.

'You are no better than the germans. And you don't care, do you ?'

recipes.label: Consult with Walther?
recipes.startdescription:
I find old priest sitting by the campfire. He's reading from the bible again, one of the only posessions he still has.

'Come closer, our situation is dire but all wars will eventually end.'

recipes.label: Consult with a priest?
recipes.startdescription:
When I pass the campfire, Walther is trying to get to me again. It's not the first time, and I know it won't be the last.

'I know it's hard for you to see it, but there's still hope out there. Just stay with me for a while to show it.'

recipes.label: <color=red>Useless Clergyman<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription:
I pass the campfire and can see Walther sitting by it. He no longer has his Bible, I ordered him to burn his useless book. We exchange spiteful glances at each other before he speaks.

'You are beyond saving.'

recipes.label: Consult with Yuri?
recipes.startdescription:
I find Yuri 'motivating' our soldiers as he usually does.

'If you won't serve in combat, you will serve on the fi-!'

I interrupt him midway to talk with him.

'Apologies comrade, those two were slacking off. I assume my assistance is needed elsewhere?'

recipes.label: Consult with Konstantin?
recipes.startdescription:
When I enter the doctor's tent, my nostrils are immiediatelly attacked by the stench of gore that always accompanies his work. The doctor stares at me from the other end of the tent as he notices me.

'If my experience is needed again, make it quick. I have many amputations to deal with today.'

recipes.label: Consult with Iosef?
recipes.startdescription:
I find Iosef where I always find him, still tucked into his makeshift bed and clutching to his cigaretes. He reluctantly stands up when I enter.

'Please... Don't tell me I am being sent out again...'

recipes.label: Consult with Nikolai?
recipes.startdescription:
Nikolai was once again busy maintaining our machinery in his spare time when I find him. He doesn't interrupt his work and barely looks at me as I talk to him.

'Yes?'

recipes.label: Consult with Fiorenza?
recipes.startdescription: I am forced to go through a few of Fiorenza's admirers while attempting to speak with her. Once she's free from them, she lets out a sigh of relief. 'Grazie... I appreciate everybody being so nice towards to me, but a break would be nice... Anyhow, is there anything I can help with?'

recipes.label: Consult with Lorenzo?
recipes.startdescription: Althought I didn't go to him for a meal, I am forced to wait in line just like everybody who wishes to taste Lorenzo's dishes. There's no shortage of grumbles as I take our cook away from the kitchen to talk. 'Just make it quick friend, our comrades won't make it for long without their spezzatino.'

recipes.label: Consult with Padre?
recipes.startdescription:
I find Padre praying at our makeshift chapel. I respectully give our exorcist time to finish his prayers before starting to talk with him.

'I wish times were better, but if you say it's time to act then I shall oblige.'

recipes.label: Consult with Daria?
recipes.startdescription:
Daria is resting calmly from a high place as she always does. She notices me in spite of me approaching in complete silence and smiles as she looks down on me.

'I knew you would be back... Who am I killing today ?'

recipes.label: Talk with a Companion
recipes.startdescription: I have some time. I can talk with my companion for a little while. [This will give you a useful memory]
recipes.description: An enjoyable diversion. Back to striving.

recipes.label: Canniballize the Fallen: Eva
recipes.startdescription:
Eva has some experience eating corpses. She can get more out of it than others could, and faster.

[This will produce more Provisions than the usual interaction, but may cause Allies without the stomach for atrocity to abandon you.]
recipes.description: Just a little more to eat, now.

recipes.label: Devour a Slain Creature: Eva
recipes.startdescription:
Eva has some experience eating corpses. She can get more out of it than others could, and faster.

[This will produce more Provisions than the usual interaction.]
recipes.description: Just a little more to eat, now.

recipes.label: Scope out the enemy: Vanja
recipes.startdescription: Someone small and quiet can probe the enemy, giving us useful intel. [This can fail, wounding Vanja]

recipes.label: Scope out the enemy: Vanja. Success!
recipes.description: Vanja comes back, with information on our enemy.

recipes.label: Scope out the enemy: Vanja. Failure!
recipes.description: Vanja comes back, crying and wounded.

recipes.label: Heal Wounded: Tibor
recipes.startdescription: The good doctor still has his healing techniques. It'll do, for this one.
recipes.description: And done. Back in the fight.

recipes.label: Heal Me: Tibor
recipes.startdescription: The good doctor still has his healing techniques. It'll do, for me.
recipes.description: I grimace as Tibor finishes stiching my wound. This will do.

recipes.label: Counselling: Walther
recipes.startdescription: What doubts do I have, what traumas do I want to get off my chest? Walther may be able to help me with them.
recipes.description:
Walther nods.

'Light persists. The dawn will arrive, eventually.'

recipes.label: Counselling?
recipes.startdescription: Hopeless, its all so hopeless. Walther can't help me.

recipes.label: <color=red>Clarity<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription: <color=red>I deserve this.<color=#005500>

recipes.label: Scour Impurity: Walter
recipes.startdescription: Walther still remembers his time as a solar clergyman. The sun can extirpate this obstacle from my path. Hopefully. [This can fail and wound Walther.]

recipes.label: Scour Impurity: Walter. Success!
recipes.description: Dawn breaks, and Walther is there. He raises his hands towards the sky. A force moves through the air. There is a light. I find my path clearer.

recipes.label: Scour Impurity: Walter. Failure!
recipes.description: Dawn breaks, and so does Walther, with a few pieces missing.

recipes.label: Scavenge Warzone: Daria
recipes.startdescription: I talk to daria about the current warzone. 'I can find some useful things here, capitan. [This can fail, wounding Daria. Sometimes this produces nothing.]

recipes.label: Scavenge Warzone: Daria. Success!
recipes.description: 'Presto!'

recipes.label: Scavenge Warzone: Daria. Failure!
recipes.description: Daria returns, battered. 'Fucking fascisti'.

recipes.label: Search the dead for anything useful: Daria
recipes.startdescription: Check their packs and pockets; their stiff and clutching hands.
recipes.description: Here's what we have to show.

recipes.label: Heal Wounded: Lorenzo
recipes.startdescription:
Lorenzo nods.

'I'll get them back in the fight.'
recipes.description: <i>Spezzatino<.i> and some rest. Back to liberation.

recipes.label: Heal Me: Lorenzo
recipes.startdescription: 'Don't worry, my friend. Some spezzatino, stiches, and bandages will do you good.
recipes.description: I wince as Lorenzo finishes patching me up. at least the spezzatino was good.

recipes.label: Cook a monstrous corpse: Lorenzo
recipes.startdescription: Lorenzo takes a moment to examine the cadaver. 'This will add flavor to the spezzatino.
recipes.description: 'Just don't ask where the meat came from.'

recipes.label: Rally a Friend: Fiorenza
recipes.startdescription:
Fiorenza smiles.

'I can motivate them!'
recipes.description: 'Keep fighting friends, we can win this!'

recipes.label: Counselling: Padre
recipes.startdescription: What doubts do I have, what traumas do I want to get off my chest? Padre may be able to help me with them.
recipes.description: Padre nods, solemnly. 'Remember why you fight. Remember the fallen. Keep your faith, no matter how many times you may fall.'

recipes.label: Exorcise Undead: Padre
recipes.startdescription: Padre has some experience putting the dead to rest. I can have him attempt to exorcise these living dead, and put them at peace once more. [This can fail, wounding Padre.]

recipes.label: Exorcise Undead: Padre. Success!
recipes.description: 'L'eterno riposo dona loro, o Signore, e splenda ad essi la luce perpetua. Riposino in pace. Amen.'

recipes.label: Exorcise Undead: Padre. Success!
recipes.description:
Padre returns, saddened and wounded.

'I have failed.'

recipes.label: Exorcise Fallen Soldiers: Padre
recipes.startdescription: These soldiers are already dead. It's time they knew that. [This won't fail.]
recipes.description: 'L'eterno riposo dona loro, o Signore, e splenda ad essi la luce perpetua. Riposino in pace. Amen.'

recipes.label: Rally a Comrade: Yuri
recipes.startdescription:
Yuri nods.

'They're shirking their duty, my friend. Let me talk to them.'
recipes.description: 'For the Motherland!'
